title: 😱Suffering Without Screaming: Healing The Modern Soul Part 3

sentences.en: Hey guys, this is Joel with the Taproot Therapy Collective podcast, and this is part three of making meaning in the modern world, or fixing the modern soul.
sentences.zh: 大家好，我是 Joel，来自 Taproot Therapy Collective 播客。这是“在现代世界中寻找意义”或“修复现代灵魂”系列的第三部分。

sentences.en: A series on what psychology is going to have to address if it's going to change to keep pace with the world and its problems that are new.

sentences.en: Some of them are old or have a symbolic root that is older, but some of them are entirely modern.

sentences.en: And one of the things that we talked about in the first episode was that the world was feeling like this kind of simulacra, or copy without an original, which is a paradox,

sentences.en: So, you know, I think the process of meaning making that I'm talking about, that takes a kind of science and a kind of spirituality, but not either, back into therapy.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，我认为我所说的意义构建过程，它需要一种科学和一种灵性，但不是二者之一，而是把它们带回治疗中。

sentences.en: I mean, we need that because we have this post-spiritual, but also post-secular culture.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我们需要这个，因为我们有这种后灵性，但也后世俗的文化。

sentences.en: I think therapists can be agents of that to hold the space that is outside of culture, outside of time, that makes room for things that we need to reflect on.
sentences.zh: 我认为治疗师可以成为这种力量的代理人，去保持那个在文化之外、在时间之外的空间，为我们需要反思的事情留出余地。

sentences.en: And that that is kind of the future, future, I hope, of what we do.
sentences.zh: 而这正是我们所做之事的未来，我希望如此。

sentences.en: Because I think that if we do that, what we're going to do is be able to see this idea of ourselves from the past, before we were corrupted with trauma, with all of the
sentences.zh: 因为我认为如果我们这样做，我们将能够看到我们过去的样子，在我们被创伤腐蚀之前，在所有

sentences.en: damage that happened, where we were young kids and we just remembered something.
sentences.zh: 发生的伤害之前，那时我们还是小孩，我们只是记得某件事。

sentences.en: Not remembered it, we just knew it.
sentences.zh: 不是记得它，我们只是知道它。

sentences.en: And then that thing is taken away from us.
sentences.zh: 然后那东西被从我们身边夺走了。

sentences.en: And therapy can take you back to that place that you always knew was there, that you always knew was you, that you always knew is this perspective
sentences.zh: 而治疗可以带你回到那个你一直知道存在的地方，那个你一直知道是你自己的地方，那个你一直知道是这种视角的地方，

sentences.en: that only you could do, but that we forget.
sentences.zh: 只有你能做到，但我们却忘记了。

sentences.en: Because we associate with all of these other things, and we blend into them, and we lose the self.
sentences.zh: 因为我们与所有这些其他事物联系在一起，我们融入了它们，我们失去了自我。

sentences.en: And if therapy is not taking you back in time, back to this thing that you can remember, but you've forgotten, then you're not really dealing with a conception of
sentences.zh: 如果治疗不能带你回到过去，回到这个你可以记住但已经忘记的东西，那么你处理的就不是我所能认同的自我概念。

sentences.en: self that I can get down with.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，它可以帮助你弄清楚如何将那个自我带入一个客观、物质、有点残酷且在物质意义上并不关心你的世界。

sentences.en: And at the same time, it can help you figure out how you bring that into a world that is objective and material and kind of cruel and doesn't care about you in a material sense.
sentences.zh: 你如何做出妥协，将那个内在的自我带出来，然后通过时间、财务、情感、你所处的文化以及你周围的其他人的局限性，

sentences.en: How you can make the compromises to take that inner self and then bring it into expression
sentences.zh: 将其表达出来。

sentences.en: through the limitations of things like time and finances and emotions and the culture that you're in and the other people who are around you.
sentences.zh: 这是一个混乱的过程，我们需要帮助。

sentences.en: And that is a messy process that we need help with.
sentences.zh: 这是一个我开始看到，你知道，回到治疗中的过程。

sentences.en: And it is a process that I am starting to see, you know, come back to therapy.
sentences.zh: 但这是我试图描述我所倾听的人们想要的东西。

sentences.en: But this is my attempt to describe what it sounds like the people that I'm listening to are saying that they want.
sentences.zh: 从这个意义上说，你知道，心理治疗本身就是一种拟像（simulacra）。

sentences.en: And in that way, you know, psychotherapy itself is kind of a semulacra.
sentences.zh: 因为它，你知道，引导你去一个其实不存在的地方。

sentences.en: Because it is, you know, leading you someplace that is no place, really.
sentences.zh: 它试图在未来和过去复制某种不存在的东西。你知道，我们直觉的知识保持着未被腐蚀和未被遗忘的状态，它是

sentences.en: It's trying to make a copy of something in the future and the past that don't exiSt. You know, where our intuitive knowledge remained uncorrupted and unforgotten, and it's
sentences.zh: 纯粹且完整的。

sentences.en: pure and in totality.
sentences.zh: 还有我们可以实现自我完善的那个自我。

sentences.en: And there's also the self that we can bring into fulfillment.
sentences.zh: 我认为，你知道，对于人类来说，有两个相当大的必然性。

sentences.en: And I think that, you know, for humans, there's two pretty big inevitabilities.
sentences.zh: 其中之一是痛苦。

sentences.en: And one of them is pain.
sentences.zh: 无论我们是否有意，我们都会伤害彼此。

sentences.en: We will hurt each other, whether or not we mean to.
sentences.zh: 我们的大部分行为要么是为了伤害别人，因为我们受了伤，要么是为了不伤害任何人，因为我们受了伤。

sentences.en: So much of our behavior goes into either trying to hurt people because we're hurt, or not hurt anybody because we're hurt.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这是一个很大的驱动力。

sentences.en: You know, it's a pretty big motivator.
sentences.zh: 它永远不会被根除或消失。

sentences.en: And it's not one that is ever going to be eradicated or go away.
sentences.zh: 另一个是爱，我们有这种能力，尽管有痛苦，依然能够连接、宽恕和存在。

sentences.en: And the other one is love, that we have this ability to, despite pain, connect and forgive and be.
sentences.zh: 伤害是不可避免的。

sentences.en: And the hurting is inevitable.
sentences.zh: 但爱不是。

sentences.en: But the loving is not.
sentences.zh: 我们记得如何去爱，因为我们不会忘记如何去伤害。

sentences.en: That we remember how to love because we're not going to forget how to hurt.
sentences.zh: 我们记得如何去爱，因为我们不会忘记如何去伤害。
